items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Frank Sebastian -- Frank Sebastian's Cotton Club.

ctx.x: It was a full length feature movie?

Yeah. Well, we only had one little spot in there, you know, very short, and that was written in. I tell you how that -- we got that spot -- was Ray Heindorf -- he did all the musical things out there at -- a lot of them anyway at Warner Brothers back there then. And he used to come in there every night to hear us, and he liked the band and this old Casa Manana, you know, and Frank Sebastian -- Frank Sebastian's Cotton Club. Then he changed it to Casa Manana in later years, out in Culver City.

And we did quite a lot of -- quite a lot of business out there when we played this room. We would stay in there about two or three weeks whenever we came in. It was a long run for us, you know. But we made the movie the same time we were out there. I remember that. We only worked on it about two days, something like that, because we just had that one spot.
